description: This file contains utility functions for PyTorch distributed training, including tensor movement, storage management, parameter synchronization, and key renaming within state dictionaries.

methods.name: _pack_kwargs
methods.description: Converts positional and keyword arguments into a tuple of args and a tuple of kwarg keys.

methods.name: _cast_forward_inputs
methods.description: Casts floating point tensors in args and kwargs to a specified dtype, respecting requires_grad.

methods.name: _unpack_kwargs
methods.description: Reconstructs args and kwargs from flattened args and kwarg keys.

methods.name: _recursive_to
methods.description: Recursively moves tensors and data structures to a specified device, optionally using side streams for copies.

methods.name: _p_assert
methods.description: Prints a message and stack trace if a condition is false; raises AssertionError if specified.

methods.name: _alloc_storage
methods.description: Allocates storage for a tensor with a given size if not already allocated.

methods.name: _free_storage
methods.description: Frees the storage of a tensor if not already freed.

methods.name: _apply_to_tensors
methods.description: Recursively applies a function to all tensors within various container types.

methods.name: _to_kwargs
methods.description: Moves inputs and kwargs to a target device, returning moved versions.

methods.name: _verify_param_shape_across_processes
methods.description: Verifies parameter shapes across distributed processes.

methods.name: _sync_module_states
methods.description: Synchronizes module parameters and buffers across processes.

methods.name: _sync_params_and_buffers
methods.description: Broadcasts module state tensors from rank 0 to all processes.

methods.name: _replace_by_prefix
methods.description: Replaces key prefixes in a state dictionary in-place.

methods.name: _data_ptr_allocated
methods.description: Checks if a tensor's storage data pointer is allocated (>0).

methods.name: _get_root_modules
methods.description: Returns modules that are root modules (not children of others) from a list.
